_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The test seeds a 12-turn conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose first two user messages have data-message-id {{FIRST}} and {{SECOND}}; the URL fragments that link to them are {{FIRST_FRAGMENT}} and {{SECOND_FRAGMENT}}. window.fragmentScrolls lists the data-message-id of every element scrolled into view so far, in order; check it with an eval of JSON.stringify(window.fragmentScrolls). Call "append" sends another message and waits for its reply; after it, {{APPENDED}} is the reply's data-message-id. To "set the fragment to X", eval a promise that sets location.hash to X and resolves on the next hashchange event. "At the bottom" means the messages container (".messages-container") has scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop below 5 and the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button") is hidden. To "delay" a message, rename its data-message-id attribute to data-delayed-message-id, as if its element had not mounted yet; to "mount" it, set data-message-id back from data-delayed-message-id (leaving the other attribute). Perform the steps in order. A jump from the table of contents is not replayed after scrolling away and appending. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the table of contents button (".toc-button") to be visible. Click it, then click the first user entry (".toc-entry-user"). window.fragmentScrolls should become ["{{FIRST}}"]. Scroll the messages container down by adding 1200 to its scrollTop. The element [data-message-id="{{FIRST}}"] should then not intersect the viewport. Call "append" and wait for an element with data-message-id {{APPENDED}} to exist. window.fragmentScrolls should still be ["{{FIRST}}"], and [data-message-id="{{FIRST}}"] still outside the viewport.

steps.expression: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector('[data-message-id="{{FIRST}}"]'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return String(r.bottom > 0 && r.top < window.innerHeight); })()
